known_boundaries: Old natural30 radial-all/five-CLEAR FAIL retained; new authorized four-quadrant settled surround is a separate contract.
Earlier line movement-evasion PASS retired by explicit instantaneous-AOE user policy.
Temporary reduced contact broadphase rejected as unsafe; motion-clear-off diagnostic FAIL and exact restore retained.

Physical fixture failures: fake same-epoch stepping, incomplete map metadata, diagnostic format bug and pre-ready background action race. Final real EnemyActor/real-epoch nine-ID test PASS; no projectile production bypass.

Final activation regression retained 5 PASS/3 FAIL; budget parser and classic124 post-hit sampling corrected in final_fixture_corrections 2 PASS; physical initialization corrected in its own PASS run.
Earlier ordinary committed/line/obstacle/surround PASS reused only for unchanged relevant boundaries, not combined into one final-source full-suite green.
PC headless CPU improvement is evidence for a phone hot-path cost inference, not phone FPS/user acceptance.
No measured input/service latency; actual attacks, HP loss, potions, motion, process intervals and memory reported separately.
Compatibility generic_melee delayed fallback has no confirmed current formal ID consumer; not declared universally validated.
Locked spells use frozen path endpoints; dynamic WORLD insertion and life/map/safety invalidation remain formal cancellation boundaries.
